content: Elementalism Beckon Element Fire and water beckoning lasts for 1 minute You exert control over the elements, creating one of the following effects within range.Beckon Air. You create a breeze strong enough to ripple cloth, stir dust, rustle leaves, and close open doors and shutters, all in a 5-foot Cube. Doors and shutters being held open by someone or something aren’t affected.Beckon Earth. You create a thin shroud of dust or sand that covers surfaces in a 5-foot-square area, or you cause a single word to appear in your handwriting in a patch of dirt or sand.Beckon Fire. You create a thin cloud of harmless embers and colored, scented smoke in a 5-foot Cube. You choose the color and scent, and the embers can light candles, torches, or lamps in that area. The smoke’s scent lingers for 1 minute.Beckon Water. You create a spray of cool mist that lightly dampens creatures and objects in a 5-foot Cube. Alternatively, you create 1 cup of clean water either in an open container or on a surface, and the water evaporates in 1 minute.Sculpt Element. You cause dirt, sand, fire, smoke, mist, or water that can fit in a 1-foot Cube to assume a crude shape (such as that of a creature) for 1 hour. Cantrip Transmutation V, S Action Instantaneous 30 ft 5 ft Cube
title: Elementalism - Beckon Element

author: fsPwfDarpkUyzlhz
content: Echoes of HalruaaA D&D 2024 campaign, levels 1 to 10+. Forgotten Realms, 1492 DR. Weekly on Foundry.A hundred years ago, the most magical kingdom in the world saved itself from the end of the world — and left everyone who didn't matter behind.Your great-grandparents were the ones who didn't matter. They sealed themselves into the mines of the Wall while the sky burned, and there they stayed. You were born under stone. So were your parents. The sky is a thing from stories.Five years ago, the mountain shook. The kingdom came back.Nobody knows what came back with it.Now the wards on the door have gone dark, three scouts haven't returned, and someone has to go out. That's you. You are the first people in a century to walk out of the Hearth and into a country where the wine is still in the casks, the fields are still in rows, and the streets are full of people who aren't quite there.What it is: Exploration of a strange, half-returned land. Plenty of fights — against things the blue fire left behind and things the returned kingdom brought with it. A mystery that unfolds through what you find, not what you're told. And, eventually, the question of who gets to decide what Halruaa becomes.What you need to know going in: Only the one-page handout. The rest you'll find, fight, or loot.What we're playing: Descendants of the left-behind, level 1, 2024 rules, Player's Handbook and Acrana Unleashed books. Combat-forward, exploration-heavy, roleplay welcome but never required. Come ready to be the first ones out the door.
